sql: SELECT r.rep_id, r.name, countIf(d.closed_date >= toStartOfMonth(today())) AS won_bulan_ini, countIf(d.closed_date >= toStartOfMonth(subtractMonths(today(), 1)) AND d.closed_date < toStartOfMonth(today())) AS won_bulan_lalu FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfMonth(subtractMonths(today(), 1)) GROUP BY r.rep_id, r.name ORDER BY r.name

question: sales mana yg omsetnya turun bulan ini dibanding bulan lalu?
sql: SELECT r.rep_id, r.name, sumIf(d.value, d.closed_date >= toStartOfMonth(today())) AS omset_bulan_ini, sumIf(d.value, d.closed_date >= toStartOfMonth(subtractMonths(today(), 1)) AND d.closed_date < toStartOfMonth(today())) AS omset_bulan_lalu FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfMonth(subtractMonths(today(), 1)) GROUP BY r.rep_id, r.name HAVING sumIf(d.value, d.closed_date >= toStartOfMonth(today())) < sumIf(d.value, d.closed_date >= toStartOfMonth(subtractMonths(today(), 1)) AND d.closed_date < toStartOfMonth(today()))

question: pelanggan mana yg tiketnya naik minggu ini dibanding minggu lalu
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, countIf(t.created_at >= toStartOfWeek(today(), 1)) AS tiket_minggu_ini, countIf(t.created_at >= toStartOfWeek(subtractWeeks(today(), 1), 1) AND t.created_at < toStartOfWeek(today(), 1)) AS tiket_minggu_lalu FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON t.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE t.created_at >= toStartOfWeek(subtractWeeks(today(), 1), 1) GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name HAVING countIf(t.created_at >= toStartOfWeek(today(), 1)) > countIf(t.created_at >= toStartOfWeek(subtractWeeks(today(), 1), 1) AND t.created_at < toStartOfWeek(today(), 1))

question: Tampilkan pertumbuhan jumlah pelanggan baru kuartal ini terhadap kuartal lalu per segmen (rasio).
sql: SELECT c.segment, countIf(c.created_at >= toStartOfQuarter(today())) AS baru_kuartal_ini, countIf(c.created_at >= toStartOfQuarter(subtractQuarters(today(), 1)) AND c.created_at < toStartOfQuarter(today())) AS baru_kuartal_lalu, round(countIf(c.created_at >= toStartOfQuarter(today())) / countIf(c.created_at >= toStartOfQuarter(subtractQuarters(today(), 1)) AND c.created_at < toStartOfQuarter(today())), 2) AS rasio_vs_kuartal_lalu FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.created_at >= toStartOfQuarter(subtractQuarters(today(), 1)) GROUP BY c.segment ORDER BY c.segment

question: rekap per tipe aktivitas: jumlah 7 hari terakhir vs 7 hari sebelumnya
sql: SELECT a.type, countIf(a.timestamp >= subtractDays(now(), 7)) AS minggu_ini, countIf(a.timestamp >= subtractDays(now(), 14) AND a.timestamp < subtractDays(now(), 7)) AS minggu_sebelumnya FROM activities AS a WHERE a.timestamp >= subtractDays(now(), 14) GROUP BY a.type ORDER BY a.type

question: omset tahun ini vs tahun lalu per kuartal (jejerkan sebagai dua kolom)
sql: SELECT toQuarter(d.closed_date) AS kuartal_ke, sumIf(d.value, d.closed_date >= toStartOfYear(today())) AS omset_tahun_ini, sumIf(d.value, d.closed_date >= toStartOfYear(subtractYears(today(), 1)) AND d.closed_date < toStartOfYear(today())) AS omset_tahun_lalu FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfYear(subtractYears(today(), 1)) GROUP BY kuartal_ke ORDER BY kuartal_ke

question: per bulan (Jan-Des): jumlah tiket tahun ini dan tahun lalu
sql: SELECT toMonth(t.created_at) AS bulan_ke, countIf(t.created_at >= toStartOfYear(today())) AS tiket_tahun_ini, countIf(t.created_at >= toStartOfYear(subtractYears(today(), 1)) AND t.created_at < toStartOfYear(today())) AS tiket_tahun_lalu FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL WHERE t.created_at >= toStartOfYear(subtractYears(today(), 1)) GROUP BY bulan_ke ORDER BY bulan_ke

question: Bandingkan win rate kuartal ini dan kuartal lalu per tim.
sql: SELECT r.team, round(countIf(d.stage = 'won' AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfQuarter(today())) / countIf(d.stage IN ('won','lost') AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfQuarter(today())), 2) AS win_rate_kuartal_ini, round(countIf(d.stage = 'won' AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfQuarter(subtractQuarters(today(), 1)) AND d.closed_date < toStartOfQuarter(today())) / countIf(d.stage IN ('won','lost') AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfQuarter(subtractQuarters(today(), 1)) AND d.closed_date < toStartOfQuarter(today())), 2) AS win_rate_kuartal_lalu FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage IN ('won','lost') AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfQuarter(subtractQuarters(today(), 1)) GROUP BY r.team ORDER BY r.team

question: rata-rata lama closing (hari) deal won, bandingkan tahun ini vs tahun lalu per segmen pelanggan
sql: SELECT c.segment, round(avgIf(dateDiff('day', d.created_date, d.closed_date), d.closed_date >= toStartOfYear(today())), 2) AS rata_hari_tahun_ini, round(avgIf(dateDiff('day', d.created_date, d.closed_date), d.closed_date >= toStartOfYear(subtractYears(today(), 1)) AND d.closed_date < toStartOfYear(today())), 2) AS rata_hari_tahun_lalu FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfYear(subtractYears(today(), 1)) GROUP BY c.segment ORDER BY c.segment

question: top 3 sales per bulan berdasarkan omset, 3 bulan terakhir
sql: SELECT x.bulan, x.rep_id, x.name, x.total_omset FROM (SELECT toStartOfMonth(d.closed_date) AS bulan, r.rep_id AS rep_id, r.name AS name, sum(d.value) AS total_omset, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY toStartOfMonth(d.closed_date) ORDER BY sum(d.value) DESC) AS urutan FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.closed_date >= subtractMonths(now(), 3) GROUP BY bulan, r.rep_id, r.name) AS x WHERE x.urutan <= 3 ORDER BY x.bulan, x.urutan

question: pelanggan teratas (omset) tiap kuartal tahun lalu, 1 per kuartal
sql: SELECT x.kuartal, x.customer_id, x.name, x.total_omset FROM (SELECT toStartOfQuarter(d.closed_date) AS kuartal, c.customer_id AS customer_id, c.name AS name, sum(d.value) AS total_omset, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY toStartOfQuarter(d.closed_date) ORDER BY sum(d.value) DESC) AS urutan FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfYear(subtractYears(today(), 1)) AND d.closed_date < toStartOfYear(today()) GROUP BY kuartal, c.customer_id, c.name) AS x WHERE x.urutan = 1 ORDER BY x.kuartal

question: tim dgn omset tertinggi di tiap bulan sepanjang tahun ini
sql: SELECT x.bulan, x.team, x.total_omset FROM (SELECT toStartOfMonth(d.closed_date) AS bulan, r.team AS team, sum(d.value) AS total_omset, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY toStartOfMonth(d.closed_date) ORDER BY sum(d.value) DESC) AS urutan FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfYear(today()) GROUP BY bulan, r.team) AS x WHERE x.urutan = 1 ORDER BY x.bulan

question: omset kumulatif per bulan tahun ini (running total)
sql: SELECT m.bulan, m.omset_bulan, sum(m.omset_bulan) OVER (ORDER BY m.bulan) AS omset_kumulatif FROM (SELECT toStartOfMonth(d.closed_date) AS bulan, sum(d.value) AS omset_bulan FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfYear(today()) GROUP BY bulan) AS m ORDER BY m.bulan

question: Rata-rata dan median lama closing deal won (hari) per kuartal tahun lalu.
sql: SELECT toStartOfQuarter(d.closed_date) AS kuartal, round(avg(dateDiff('day', d.created_date, d.closed_date)), 2) AS rata_hari, quantile(0.5)(dateDiff('day', d.created_date, d.closed_date)) AS median_hari FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfYear(subtractYears(today(), 1)) AND d.closed_date < toStartOfYear(today()) GROUP BY kuartal ORDER BY kuartal

question: lama closing deal won per produk per tahun (hari, rata2)
sql: SELECT toYear(d.closed_date) AS tahun, produk, round(avg(dateDiff('day', d.created_date, d.closed_date)), 2) AS rata_hari_closing FROM deals AS d FINAL ARRAY JOIN d.products_involved AS produk WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY tahun, produk ORDER BY tahun, produk

question: Berapa rata-rata hari dari pelanggan daftar ke deal pertamanya dibuat? per segmen
sql: SELECT c.segment, round(avg(dateDiff('day', c.created_at, f.deal_pertama)), 2) AS rata_hari FROM customers AS c FINAL INNER JOIN (SELECT d.customer_id AS customer_id, min(d.created_date) AS deal_pertama FROM deals AS d FINAL GROUP BY d.customer_id) AS f ON c.customer_id = f.customer_id GROUP BY c.segment ORDER BY c.segment

question: rata-rata hari sejak daftar sampai deal won pertama, utk pelanggan yg daftar tahun lalu
sql: SELECT round(avg(dateDiff('day', c.created_at, w.won_pertama)), 2) AS rata_hari FROM customers AS c FINAL INNER JOIN (SELECT d.customer_id AS customer_id, min(d.closed_date) AS won_pertama FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY d.customer_id) AS w ON c.customer_id = w.customer_id WHERE c.created_at >= toStartOfYear(subtractYears(today(), 1)) AND c.created_at < toStartOfYear(today())

question: jarak hari antara deal dibuat dan aktivitas terakhir pelanggan itu, untuk deal berjalan yg dibuat 6 bulan terakhir (top 10 terlama)

question: deal berjalan yg pelanggannya tidak ada aktivitas 30 hari terakhir, tampilkan nama pelanggan dan umur deal (hari)

question: pelanggan yg daftar 6 bulan terakhir dan punya minimal satu deal won, tampilkan total omsetnya

question: omset per bulan kohort pelanggan yg daftar tahun lalu (omset dihitung berdasarkan bulan closing tahun ini)

question: tiket per pelanggan baru (daftar bulan lalu): tampilkan pelanggan dan jumlah tiketnya sejak daftar

question: Per tim, hitung jumlah aktivitas dan jumlah deal won bulan ini (hati-hati jangan dikali).

question: Tampilkan bulan-bulan tahun ini dimana omset di bawah rata-rata omset bulanan tahun ini.
sql: SELECT m.bulan, m.total_omset FROM (SELECT toStartOfMonth(d.closed_date) AS bulan, sum(d.value) AS total_omset FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfYear(today()) GROUP BY bulan) AS m WHERE m.total_omset < (SELECT avg(s.total_omset) FROM (SELECT sum(d.value) AS total_omset FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfYear(today()) GROUP BY toStartOfMonth(d.closed_date)) AS s) ORDER BY m.bulan

question: minggu2 dlm 12 minggu terakhir dimana jumlah tiket di atas rata-rata mingguan
sql: SELECT w.minggu, w.jumlah_tiket FROM (SELECT toStartOfWeek(t.created_at, 1) AS minggu, count() AS jumlah_tiket FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL WHERE t.created_at >= subtractWeeks(now(), 12) GROUP BY minggu) AS w WHERE w.jumlah_tiket > (SELECT avg(s.jumlah_tiket) FROM (SELECT count() AS jumlah_tiket FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL WHERE t.created_at >= subtractWeeks(now(), 12) GROUP BY toStartOfWeek(t.created_at, 1)) AS s) ORDER BY w.minggu

question: selisih omset bulan ini dengan bulan lalu dalam rupiah dan rasio perubahannya
sql: SELECT sumIf(d.value, d.closed_date >= toStartOfMonth(today())) AS omset_bulan_ini, sumIf(d.value, d.closed_date >= toStartOfMonth(subtractMonths(today(), 1)) AND d.closed_date < toStartOfMonth(today())) AS omset_bulan_lalu, sumIf(d.value, d.closed_date >= toStartOfMonth(today())) - sumIf(d.value, d.closed_date >= toStartOfMonth(subtractMonths(today(), 1)) AND d.closed_date < toStartOfMonth(today())) AS selisih, round((sumIf(d.value, d.closed_date >= toStartOfMonth(today())) - sumIf(d.value, d.closed_date >= toStartOfMonth(subtractMonths(today(), 1)) AND d.closed_date < toStartOfMonth(today()))) / sumIf(d.value, d.closed_date >= toStartOfMonth(subtractMonths(today(), 1)) AND d.closed_date < toStartOfMonth(today())), 2) AS rasio_perubahan FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfMonth(subtractMonths(today(), 1))

question: MoM jumlah deal baru per segmen pelanggan: bulan ini vs bulan lalu
sql: SELECT c.segment, countIf(d.created_date >= toStartOfMonth(today())) AS deal_bulan_ini, countIf(d.created_date >= toStartOfMonth(subtractMonths(today(), 1)) AND d.created_date < toStartOfMonth(today())) AS deal_bulan_lalu FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE d.created_date >= toStartOfMonth(subtractMonths(today(), 1)) GROUP BY c.segment ORDER BY c.segment

question: per prioritas, bandingkan jumlah tiket yang belum selesai (open/in_progress) dibuat tahun ini vs tahun lalu

question: rata-rata waktu resolusi tiket per prioritas: 3 bulan terakhir vs 3 bulan sebelumnya

question: deal won per bulan dalam 6 bulan terakhir: jumlah, omset, dan rata-rata nilai per deal

question: per kuartal tahun ini: deal dibuat, deal won, dan deal lost (berdasarkan tanggal dibuat)
sql: SELECT toStartOfQuarter(d.created_date) AS kuartal, count() AS deal_dibuat, countIf(d.stage = 'won') AS deal_won, countIf(d.stage = 'lost') AS deal_lost FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.created_date >= toStartOfYear(today()) GROUP BY kuartal ORDER BY kuartal

question: Kelompokkan pelanggan baru tahun ini per bulan: total, yang masih active, dan yang churned.
sql: SELECT toStartOfMonth(c.created_at) AS bulan, count() AS total_baru, countIf(c.status = 'active') AS jumlah_active, countIf(c.status = 'churned') AS jumlah_churned FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.created_at >= toStartOfYear(today()) GROUP BY bulan ORDER BY bulan

question: tiket per bulan tahun ini: total, urgent, dan persentase tiket yg belum selesai (rasio)
sql: SELECT toStartOfMonth(t.created_at) AS bulan, count() AS total_tiket, countIf(t.priority = 'urgent') AS tiket_urgent, round(countIf(t.status IN ('open','in_progress')) / count(), 2) AS rasio_belum_selesai FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL WHERE t.created_at >= toStartOfYear(today()) GROUP BY bulan ORDER BY bulan

question: Rekap harian aktivitas 7 hari terakhir: jumlah, total durasi, dan jumlah pelanggan unik.

question: p90 waktu resolusi tiket (jam) per bulan tahun ini
sql: SELECT toStartOfMonth(t.created_at) AS bulan, quantile(0.9)(t.resolution_time_hours) AS p90_jam_resolusi FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL WHERE t.created_at >= toStartOfYear(today()) GROUP BY bulan ORDER BY bulan

question: p75 lama closing (hari) deal won per tim, tahun lalu
sql: SELECT r.team, quantile(0.75)(dateDiff('day', d.created_date, d.closed_date)) AS p75_hari_closing FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfYear(subtractYears(today(), 1)) AND d.closed_date < toStartOfYear(today()) GROUP BY r.team ORDER BY r.team

question: hari dalam seminggu x jenis aktivitas: jumlah aktivitas 3 bulan terakhir

question: jam sibuk (jam dgn aktivitas terbanyak) per tipe aktivitas, tampilkan 1 jam teratas tiap tipe
sql: SELECT x.type, x.jam, x.jumlah_aktivitas FROM (SELECT a.type AS type, toHour(a.timestamp) AS jam, count() AS jumlah_aktivitas, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY a.type ORDER BY count() DESC) AS urutan FROM activities AS a GROUP BY a.type, jam) AS x WHERE x.urutan = 1 ORDER BY x.type

question: tiap tim: hari apa deal paling sering won?
sql: SELECT x.team, x.hari, x.jumlah_deal_won FROM (SELECT r.team AS team, toDayOfWeek(d.closed_date) AS hari, count() AS jumlah_deal_won, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY r.team ORDER BY count() DESC) AS urutan FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY r.team, hari) AS x WHERE x.urutan = 1 ORDER BY x.team

question: Berapa lama rata-rata (hari) tiap sales dari deal dibuat hingga won, hanya sales dgn minimal 5 deal won tahun ini
sql: SELECT r.rep_id, r.name, round(avg(dateDiff('day', d.created_date, d.closed_date)), 2) AS rata_hari_closing, count() AS jumlah_deal_won FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfYear(today()) GROUP BY r.rep_id, r.name HAVING count() >= 5 ORDER BY rata_hari_closing

question: pelanggan Enterprise dgn deal won 6 bulan terakhir, tampilkan nama, total omset, dan kapan deal won terakhirnya

question: deal won tahun ini yg dibuat tahun lalu (cross-year), jumlah dan omsetnya per tim

question: deal yg dibuat dan ditutup (won) di bulan kalender yang sama, per bulan tahun ini

sql: SELECT argMax(m.bulan, m.total_omset) AS bulan_tertinggi, max(m.total_omset) AS omset_tertinggi, argMin(m.bulan, m.total_omset) AS bulan_terendah, min(m.total_omset) AS omset_terendah FROM (SELECT toStartOfMonth(d.closed_date) AS bulan, sum(d.value) AS total_omset FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfYear(subtractYears(today(), 1)) AND d.closed_date < toStartOfYear(today()) GROUP BY bulan) AS m

question: kontribusi omset tiap bulan terhadap total omset tahun lalu (rasio)
sql: SELECT m.bulan, m.total_omset, round(m.total_omset / sum(m.total_omset) OVER (), 2) AS rasio_kontribusi FROM (SELECT toStartOfMonth(d.closed_date) AS bulan, sum(d.value) AS total_omset FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfYear(subtractYears(today(), 1)) AND d.closed_date < toStartOfYear(today()) GROUP BY bulan) AS m ORDER BY m.bulan

question: rata-rata bergerak 3 bulan untuk omset bulanan tahun lalu dan tahun ini
sql: SELECT m.bulan, m.total_omset, round(avg(m.total_omset) OVER (ORDER BY m.bulan ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 2) AS rata_bergerak_3_bulan FROM (SELECT toStartOfMonth(d.closed_date) AS bulan, sum(d.value) AS total_omset FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfYear(subtractYears(today(), 1)) GROUP BY bulan) AS m ORDER BY m.bulan

question: pelanggan yg bikin tiket 60 hari terakhir tapi nggak ada aktivitas apapun 30 hari terakhir
sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.customer_id, c.name FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON t.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE t.created_at >= subtractDays(now(), 60) AND t.customer_id NOT IN (SELECT a.customer_id FROM activities AS a WHERE a.timestamp >= subtractDays(now(), 30))

question: tanggal deal won pertama tiap sales tahun ini beserta jumlah deal won-nya
sql: SELECT r.rep_id, r.name, min(d.closed_date) AS won_pertama, count() AS jumlah_deal_won FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfYear(today()) GROUP BY r.rep_id, r.name ORDER BY won_pertama

question: Hitung jumlah hari kerja (senin-jumat) yg ada aktivitasnya per sales bulan lalu
sql: SELECT r.rep_id, r.name, uniqExact(toDate(a.timestamp)) AS hari_aktif FROM activities AS a INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON a.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE a.timestamp >= toStartOfMonth(subtractMonths(today(), 1)) AND a.timestamp < toStartOfMonth(today()) AND toDayOfWeek(a.timestamp) <= 5 GROUP BY r.rep_id, r.name ORDER BY hari_aktif DESC

question: win rate per bulan tahun ini untuk deal yg dibuat tahun lalu
sql: SELECT toStartOfMonth(d.closed_date) AS bulan, round(countIf(d.stage = 'won') / countIf(d.stage IN ('won','lost')), 2) AS win_rate FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage IN ('won','lost') AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfYear(today()) AND d.created_date >= toStartOfYear(subtractYears(today(), 1)) AND d.created_date < toStartOfYear(today()) GROUP BY bulan ORDER BY bulan

question: rasio churn pelanggan per kuartal pendaftaran selama 2 tahun terakhir per segmen
sql: SELECT toStartOfQuarter(c.created_at) AS kuartal, c.segment, round(countIf(c.status = 'churned') / count(), 2) AS rasio_churn FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.created_at >= subtractYears(now(), 2) GROUP BY kuartal, c.segment ORDER BY kuartal, c.segment

question: deal won QTD vs QTD kuartal sebelumnya (jumlah hari sama sejak awal kuartal)
sql: SELECT countIf(d.closed_date >= toStartOfQuarter(today())) AS won_qtd, countIf(d.closed_date >= toStartOfQuarter(subtractQuarters(today(), 1)) AND d.closed_date < subtractQuarters(now(), 1)) AS won_qtd_kuartal_lalu FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfQuarter(subtractQuarters(today(), 1))

question: omset MTD vs periode yang sama bulan lalu (awal bulan lalu sampai tanggal yg sama)
sql: SELECT sumIf(d.value, d.closed_date >= toStartOfMonth(today())) AS omset_mtd, sumIf(d.value, d.closed_date >= toStartOfMonth(subtractMonths(today(), 1)) AND d.closed_date < subtractMonths(now(), 1)) AS omset_mtd_bulan_lalu FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfMonth(subtractMonths(today(), 1))

question: jumlah tiket YTD vs YTD tahun lalu per prioritas
sql: SELECT t.priority, countIf(t.created_at >= toStartOfYear(today())) AS tiket_ytd, countIf(t.created_at >= toStartOfYear(subtractYears(today(), 1)) AND t.created_at < subtractYears(now(), 1)) AS tiket_ytd_tahun_lalu FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL WHERE t.created_at >= toStartOfYear(subtractYears(today(), 1)) GROUP BY t.priority ORDER BY t.priority

question: pelanggan baru YTD dibanding YTD tahun lalu per segmen
sql: SELECT c.segment, countIf(c.created_at >= toStartOfYear(today())) AS baru_ytd, countIf(c.created_at >= toStartOfYear(subtractYears(today(), 1)) AND c.created_at < subtractYears(now(), 1)) AS baru_ytd_tahun_lalu FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.created_at >= toStartOfYear(subtractYears(today(), 1)) GROUP BY c.segment ORDER BY c.segment

question: omset YTD per tim vs YTD tahun lalu, hanya tim yg naik
sql: SELECT r.team, sumIf(d.value, d.closed_date >= toStartOfYear(today())) AS omset_ytd, sumIf(d.value, d.closed_date >= toStartOfYear(subtractYears(today(), 1)) AND d.closed_date < subtractYears(now(), 1)) AS omset_ytd_tahun_lalu FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfYear(subtractYears(today(), 1)) GROUP BY r.team HAVING sumIf(d.value, d.closed_date >= toStartOfYear(today())) > sumIf(d.value, d.closed_date >= toStartOfYear(subtractYears(today(), 1)) AND d.closed_date < subtractYears(now(), 1)) ORDER BY r.team

question: rekap per minggu 8 minggu terakhir: omset, jumlah deal won, dan jumlah deal lost
sql: SELECT toStartOfWeek(d.closed_date, 1) AS minggu, sumIf(d.value, d.stage = 'won') AS total_omset, countIf(d.stage = 'won') AS jumlah_won, countIf(d.stage = 'lost') AS jumlah_lost FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage IN ('won','lost') AND d.closed_date >= subtractWeeks(now(), 8) GROUP BY minggu ORDER BY minggu

question: 5 pelanggan active dengan tiket open tertua (umur hari)
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, max(dateDiff('day', t.created_at, now())) AS umur_tiket_hari FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON t.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE c.status = 'active' AND t.status = 'open' GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name ORDER BY umur_tiket_hari DESC LIMIT 5

question: rata-rata umur tiket yg belum selesai (hari) per prioritas, hanya tiket yg dibuat 12 bulan terakhir
sql: SELECT t.priority, round(avg(dateDiff('day', t.created_at, now())), 2) AS rata_umur_hari FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL WHERE t.status IN ('open','in_progress') AND t.created_at >= subtractMonths(now(), 12) GROUP BY t.priority ORDER BY t.priority

question: deal won bulan lalu yang butuh lebih dari 90 hari dari dibuat sampai closing
sql: SELECT d.deal_id, d.title, d.stage, d.value, dateDiff('day', d.created_date, d.closed_date) AS lama_hari FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfMonth(subtractMonths(today(), 1)) AND d.closed_date < toStartOfMonth(today()) AND dateDiff('day', d.created_date, d.closed_date) > 90

question: jumlah tiket dibuat per jam dalam sehari, khusus minggu lalu
sql: SELECT toHour(t.created_at) AS jam, count() AS jumlah_tiket FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL WHERE t.created_at >= toStartOfWeek(subtractWeeks(today(), 1), 1) AND t.created_at < toStartOfWeek(today(), 1) GROUP BY jam ORDER BY jam

question: rata-rata nilai deal lost per bulan 6 bulan belakangan
sql: SELECT toStartOfMonth(d.closed_date) AS bulan, round(avg(d.value), 2) AS rata_nilai_lost FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'lost' AND d.closed_date >= subtractMonths(now(), 6) GROUP BY bulan ORDER BY bulan

question: kapan terakhir tiap pelanggan Enterprise bikin tiket? tampilkan 10 yg paling baru
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, max(t.created_at) AS tiket_terakhir FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON t.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE c.segment = 'Enterprise' GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name ORDER BY tiket_terakhir DESC LIMIT 10

question: per segmen: rata-rata hari dari tiket dibuat sampai updated, bandingkan 3 bulan terakhir vs 3 bulan sebelumnya
sql: SELECT c.segment, round(avgIf(dateDiff('day', t.created_at, t.updated_at), t.created_at >= subtractMonths(now(), 3)), 2) AS rata_hari_3_bulan_terakhir, round(avgIf(dateDiff('day', t.created_at, t.updated_at), t.created_at >= subtractMonths(now(), 6) AND t.created_at < subtractMonths(now(), 3)), 2) AS rata_hari_3_bulan_sebelumnya FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON t.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE t.created_at >= subtractMonths(now(), 6) GROUP BY c.segment ORDER BY c.segment

question: omset per tim kuartal lalu, hanya tim dengan lebih dari 5 deal won, urut tertinggi
sql: SELECT r.team, count() AS jumlah_deal_won, sum(d.value) AS total_omset FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfQuarter(subtractQuarters(today(), 1)) AND d.closed_date < toStartOfQuarter(today()) GROUP BY r.team HAVING count() > 5 ORDER BY total_omset DESC

question: sales mana yg jumlah aktivitasnya bulan ini lebih banyak dari rata-rata aktivitas per sales bulan ini
sql: SELECT r.rep_id, r.name, count() AS jumlah_aktivitas FROM activities AS a INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON a.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE a.timestamp >= toStartOfMonth(today()) GROUP BY r.rep_id, r.name HAVING count() > (SELECT avg(s.jumlah) FROM (SELECT count() AS jumlah FROM activities AS a WHERE a.timestamp >= toStartOfMonth(today()) GROUP BY a.rep_id) AS s) ORDER BY jumlah_aktivitas DESC
